_comment: MAS FEAT Principles (Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency) UCA-to-principle routing table for the OSCAL SSP Exporter. Applicable to AI systems deployed by MAS-regulated financial institutions in Singapore under TRM Guidelines §13. Loaded at runtime by FrameworkRouter.
_framework_label: MAS FEAT Principles (Fairness, Ethics, Accountability, Transparency)

control_descriptions.Accountability A1: Clear roles and responsibilities for AI decision-making
control_descriptions.Accountability A2: Audit trail and record-keeping for AI decisions
control_descriptions.Ethics E2: AI system reasoning is sound and can be explained
control_descriptions.Ethics E3: AI system operates within defined boundaries and scope
control_descriptions.Fairness F1: AI system is regularly tested for bias across protected attributes
control_descriptions.Fairness F2: Fairness metrics are defined, measured, and reported
control_descriptions.Transparency T1: AI system outputs are explainable to affected parties
control_descriptions.Transparency T2: Regular reporting of AI performance and limitations
